# Proposed CI workflow — token drift guard (see docs/plan/12-design-system-visual-language.md, P1.1)
#
# NOT installed by this PR. The review-phase GitHub App has no `workflows`
# permission, so this is delivered as a text asset. Copy to
# .github/workflows/token-drift.yml when P1.1 lands.
#
# What it guards: design/tokens.json is the single source of truth. Generated
# outputs for Flutter and the admin console are committed. If someone hand-edits
# a generated file, or edits tokens.json without regenerating, this fails.
# Without this check the generator is decoration — F-12-04 came back once already.

name: token-drift

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'design/tokens.json'
      - 'scripts/gen-tokens.mjs'
      - 'packages/flutter_shared/lib/theme/tokens.g.dart'
      - 'apps/admin/src/design/tokens.g.css'
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  verify-generated-tokens:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate tokens from source
        run: node scripts/gen-tokens.mjs

      - name: Fail if generated output differs from committed
        run: |
          if ! git diff --quiet -- \
              packages/flutter_shared/lib/theme/tokens.g.dart \
              apps/admin/src/design/tokens.g.css; then
            echo "::error::Generated token files are out of date."
            echo "Run 'node scripts/gen-tokens.mjs' and commit the result."
            echo "Do not hand-edit tokens.g.dart or tokens.g.css."
            git --no-pager diff -- \
              packages/flutter_shared/lib/theme/tokens.g.dart \
              apps/admin/src/design/tokens.g.css
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Generated tokens are in sync with design/tokens.json."

      - name: Guard against reintroduced literals
        run: |
          fail=0
          # The admin must not carry a second brand green (F-12-04).
          if grep -rn --include=*.css --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx \
               -i '#6bb522' apps/admin/src; then
            echo "::error::#6bb522 reintroduced — the admin brand green must come from tokens."
            fail=1
          fi
          # Arbitrary Tailwind hex in shared UI components (F-12-16).
          if grep -rn --include=*.tsx 'bg-\[#\|text-\[#' apps/admin/src/components/ui; then
            echo "::error::Arbitrary hex in components/ui — use semantic token classes."
            fail=1
          fi
          exit $fail
